headline: Supertanker Strikes Mine in Strait of Hormuz, Spilling Two Million Barrels of Oil
summary: A supertanker carrying over two million barrels of crude oil caught fire after striking a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz alongside three other commercial tankers.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical maritime choke point for global oil transport, where disruptions directly threaten crude supply and energy security.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Mine attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz interrupt crude transit and raise supply security risks.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Reports of damaged tankers in the vital Strait of Hormuz raise immediate concerns over crude oil transit disruptions through the Persian Gulf.
